title: Run Provenance
description: Common Job Run execution provenance shared by every V1 job type (Architecture Baseline section 13.1). The mandatory downstream dependency policy keyed on status, and the requirement that CI-triggered runs (as opposed to local runs) always carry git_commit/git_ref, are Engine/domain logic and are NOT enforced by this schema. See packages/contracts/README.md.

JobType.description: Closed V1 job type vocabulary (Architecture Baseline section 13.1).

finished_at.description: When execution reached a terminal status. Absent while PENDING/RUNNING.

trigger.description: What triggered this run. Kept as a free-form string in V1 rather than a closed enum (ADR-009 decision 9); no downstream policy is defined against a fixed vocabulary for this field.

git_commit.description: Commit the run executed from. Required for CI-triggered runs; may be absent for local runs (ADR-009 decision 10). Which runs are CI-triggered, and the weaker reproducibility guarantee when this field is absent, is Engine/domain logic, not enforced here.

git_ref.description: Branch/tag/ref the run executed from. Same CI-vs-local nullability as git_commit.

environment.description: Execution environment (e.g. CI, local, future worker). Kept as a free-form string in V1 rather than a closed enum (ADR-009 decision 9).

workflow_run_id.description: GitHub Actions workflow run identifier. Present only when triggered via GitHub Actions; absent for local CLI runs (Architecture Baseline section 18).

error_summary.description: Human-readable error summary. Populated on FAILED/PARTIAL/CANCELLED; absent otherwise.

metadata.description: Free-form, job-type-specific metadata. Intentionally unconstrained because the Architecture Baseline describes this field as free-form and job-specific; constraining its shape here would either invent structure the baseline does not define, or require a per-job-type schema, both out of scope for the Phase 0 minimum.
